about_the_game:
Aleato is a dynamic roguelike dice game where you aim to surpass each level's score by strategically experimenting with a diverse array of unique builds each game.

 

  
The game boasts an extensive selection of over 100+ unique perks, empowering you to craft a distinct and personalized build every run. Harness the might of EvenSteven to unlock multiplication bonuses for even-numbered rolls, or tap into PrimeTime to boost your score with enhanced rewards for dice landing on prime numbers. With countless combinations to explore, every perk adds a fresh layer of strategy to conquer the game’s challenges.

You can forge an array of special dice by unlocking recipes through creative experimentation or steady progress in the game. As you play, you'll uncover new combinations, allowing you to customize your dice to suit your preferred playstyle, adding depth and replayability to each run.

Fuse your crafted dice with perks to forge potent builds, enabling you to triumphantly exceed each level's challenging score threshold. By synergizing these elements, you can explore countless strategic combinations, tailoring your approach to conquer increasingly demanding stages with creativity and finesse, ensuring every run feels fresh and exhilarating.

Aleato offers a diverse collection of specialized dice, each designed to enhance your strategic gameplay. Unleash the Bomb Dice to reroll neighboring dice, giving you a tactical advantage with every toss, or wield the timeless Joker Dice to amplify your combo potential. With a wealth of other unique dice awaiting discovery, you’ll uncover new ways to master each run and outsmart the challenges ahead.
